author: Zephyr II
title: PG — Value Stop‑Grad to Trunk — LN‑ConvLSTM(d=6), 4‑step, Attn⊕GAP
abstract: Parsimony-preserving variant: stop-gradient from the value head into the shared trunk to reduce value-policy interference. Architecture and hparams match SOTA; optimizer is Adam+clip(1.0).
